faq.create_business_q: How do I create a new business?
faq.create_business_a: Go to the Business page from the sidebar and click "New Business". Fill in the required details like business name, type, and optionally GST number and address. Click "Create" and your business will be ready to use.
faq.switch_business_q: How do I switch between businesses?
faq.switch_business_a: Click on the business name in the sidebar to see the business switcher dropdown. Select any business from the list to switch. You can also manage businesses from the Businesses page.
faq.record_purchase_q: How do I record a purchase?
faq.record_purchase_a: Navigate to Purchases > New Purchase. Select the supplier, add items with quantities and rates, and save. The purchase will automatically update inventory, ledger, and outstanding balances.
faq.create_sale_q: How do I create a sale?
faq.create_sale_a: Go to Sales > New Sale. Select the customer party, add lots or items to sell, enter rates, and complete the sale. Inventory stock will be automatically reduced.
faq.record_payment_q: How do I record a payment?
faq.record_payment_a: Go to the Payments page and click "Record Payment". Select the party, enter the amount, payment mode (cash/bank/UPI), and any reference notes. This will update the party's outstanding balance.
faq.low_stock_q: What happens when stock is low?
faq.low_stock_a: When an item's stock falls below its minimum stock level, a low-stock alert appears on the Dashboard and Inventory pages. You can set custom minimum stock levels for each item.
faq.reports_a: Bahi Khata Pro offers Day Book, Trial Balance, Profit & Loss Statement, and Outstanding reports. All reports support date range filters and can be exported as CSV, JSON, or printed.
faq.upgrade_q: How do I upgrade my plan?
faq.upgrade_a: Go to Subscription page from the sidebar. Compare available plans and click "Upgrade" on your preferred plan. Payment can be made via UPI, card, or net banking.
faq.export_a: Yes! Every page with a table has an Export button supporting CSV and JSON formats. You can also import data from CSV files using the Import button available on Purchases, Sales, Inventory, and Parties pages.
faq.team_q: How do I invite team members?
faq.team_a: Use the Referrals page to share your referral code. Team members can sign up with the code for mutual benefits. Full multi-user access per business is coming soon!
